response.what_it_is: Brush cutter gear head / gearbox assembly
hidden_risks: Spline count and shaft diameter compatibility (e.g., 7 or 9 spline, 26mm or 28mm tube)
Quality and durability of internal gears and bearings
Proper factory lubrication inside the gearbox
response.best_proof: A close-up photo looking down the shaft receiver to count the splines and measure the diameter
response.failure_mode: Mistaking the branded retail boxes in the background for the item itself or confusing the replacement part for a complete brush cutter machine.
